description: Experience the viral sensation of Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread right in your own kitchen. This delightful treat features soft, fluffy bread generously filled with a sweet cream cheese mixture and then dipped in a savory garlic butter sauce. It's the perfect balance of sweet and savory, making it an irresistible snack or side dish.

ingredients.item: Round bread rolls or milk buns

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 160C (325F). Take each round bread roll and slice it into 6-8 equal wedges, making sure not to cut all the way through the bottom so the bread remains intact at the base.

instructions.title: Make the Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, 2 tablespoons of granulated sugar, 2 tablespoons of heavy cream, and 1/4 teaspoon of salt. Mix thoroughly with a spatula or whisk until the mixture is smooth and lump-free. Transfer the filling into a piping bag or a ziplock bag with a corner snipped off.

instructions.title: Prepare the Garlic Butter Sauce
instructions.text: In another bowl, whisk together the melted unsalted butter, minced garlic, mayonnaise, beaten egg, 1 tablespoon of granulated sugar, dried parsley, and milk until well combined. This will be your savory and sweet garlic coating.

instructions.title: Assemble the Bread
instructions.text: Carefully open the wedges of each bread roll and pipe the cream cheese filling generously into the crevices. Ensure an even distribution of the sweet cream cheese throughout each cut of the bread.

instructions.title: Dip and Coat
instructions.text: Dip each filled bread roll into the garlic butter sauce, ensuring all sides and crevices are thoroughly coated. You can use a spoon to pour the sauce over the bread if dipping is too messy. Place the coated breads on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

instructions.title: Bake to Golden Perfection
instructions.text: Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown and the cream cheese filling is bubbly and slightly caramelized. The garlic butter should be absorbed, leaving a fragrant crust.

instructions.title: Serve Warm
instructions.text: Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving. Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is best enjoyed warm, when the bread is soft, the filling is gooey, and the garlic butter is fragrant.

tips: For the best texture, ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature for a smooth, easy-to-pipe filling.
Use fresh garlic for the most aromatic garlic butter sauce; avoid pre-minced jarred garlic for superior flavor.
Serve immediately after baking for the ultimate gooey cheese and crispy crust experience. Leftovers can be gently reheated in an oven or air fryer.
article:
Get ready to embark on a culinary journey that has taken the world by storm: Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread. This viral sensation, hailing from the vibrant street food scene and bakeries of South Korea, is a delightful fusion of sweet and savory that promises an unforgettable taste experience. Forget everything you thought you knew about garlic bread; this Korean rendition elevates it to an art form, featuring a soft, fluffy bread base generously slathered in a rich garlic butter glaze and filled with a luscious, slightly sweet cream cheese mixture. If you're eager to recreate this magic in your own kitchen, you've come to the right place. Let's dive into the delicious world of Korean baking and discover how to make this irresistible treat.

## What is Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread?

Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread, often simply called "Korean Garlic Bread," is a unique and incredibly popular street food and bakery item from South Korea. Unlike its Western counterpart, which is typically a savory side dish, the Korean version is a sweet and savory masterpiece designed to be a standalone snack or dessert. It starts with individual buns, often brioche or milk bread, which are deeply cut into wedges without going all the way through the bottom. These cuts are then generously filled with a sweet cream cheese mixture. The entire bun is then submerged and brushed with a fragrant, savory-sweet garlic butter glaze, which often includes an egg to help emulsify the mixture and provide a beautiful golden sheen. The result is a bread that is crispy on the outside, incredibly soft and fluffy on the inside, with pockets of creamy, tangy sweetness complementing the rich, garlicky exterior. The combination of textures and flavors is what makes Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread so addictive and beloved worldwide.

## Ingredients You'll Need

Creating authentic Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread requires a few key components, each playing a vital role in achieving that perfect balance of flavors and textures.

**For the Bread:**
*   **6-8 Soft Bread Buns:** Individual brioche buns, milk bread buns, or even good quality store-bought dinner rolls work perfectly. The key is a soft, slightly sweet bread.

**For the Cream Cheese Filling:**
*   **8 oz (226g) Cream Cheese:** Softened at room temperature.
*   **2-3 tablespoons Granulated Sugar:** Adjust to your sweetness preference.
*   **1-2 tablespoons Milk or Heavy Cream:** To achieve a smooth, pipeable consistency.

**For the Garlic Butter Glaze:**
*   **1/2 cup (113g) Unsalted Butter:** Melted.
*   **6-8 cloves Garlic:** Minced very finely.
*   **2 tablespoons Granulated Sugar or Honey:** For that signature sweet note.
*   **1 large Egg:** Beaten. This helps emulsify the sauce and gives a glossy finish.
*   **1 tablespoon Dried Parsley Flakes:** For color and a subtle herby note.
*   **1/4 teaspoon Salt:** To balance the flavors.

**Optional Garnish:**
*   Fresh chopped parsley or sesame seeds.

## Step-by-Step Instructions

Making Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread at home is surprisingly straightforward and incredibly rewarding. Follow these steps for a delicious result.

**Step 1: Prepare the Bread**
Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). Take each bread bun and, using a sharp knife, make 6-8 deep cuts around the bun, radiating from the center, without cutting all the way through the bottom. You want the cuts to be deep enough to create pockets for the filling but still keep the bun intact. Place the cut buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

**Step 2: Make the Cream Cheese Filling**
In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, sugar, and milk (or heavy cream). Beat with a whisk or electric mixer until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy, with no lumps. Transfer this filling into a piping bag fitted with a round tip (or a zip-top bag with a corner snipped off).

**Step 3: Fill the Bread**
Carefully pipe the cream cheese filling into each of the cuts you made in the bread buns. Be generous, ensuring each wedge is filled with a good amount of the creamy mixture.

**Step 4: Prepare the Garlic Butter Glaze**
In another bowl, melt the unsalted butter. Add the finely minced garlic, sugar (or honey), dried parsley flakes, and salt. Whisk everything together thoroughly. Once combined, slowly whisk in the beaten egg until the mixture is fully emulsified and looks smooth. The egg helps bind the sauce and will give the bread a beautiful golden-brown, glossy finish when baked.

**Step 5: Dunk and Glaze**
This is where the magic happens! Take each cream cheese-filled bun and gently dunk it entirely into the garlic butter glaze. Make sure to rotate it so all sides and crevices are thoroughly coated. Alternatively, you can generously brush the glaze over and into all parts of the bread. Place the glazed buns back on the parchment-lined baking sheet.

**Step 6: Bake**
Bake the Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread in your preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the bread is golden brown, the cream cheese filling is bubbly, and the garlic butter glaze is fragrant and slightly caramelized. Keep an eye on it to prevent burning.

**Step 7: Garnish and Serve**
Once baked, remove the bread from the oven. If desired, sprinkle with fresh chopped parsley or a few sesame seeds for an extra touch. Serve immediately while warm and gooey.

## Pro Tips for Perfect Results

To ensure your homemade Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is as delicious as the bakery version, consider these expert tips:

*   **Choose Your Bread Wisely:** The foundation is crucial. Opt for fresh, soft, slightly sweet buns. Brioche or milk bread are ideal as they absorb the glaze beautifully and remain tender.
*   **Soften Cream Cheese Properly:** Ensure your cream cheese is at room temperature for a lump-free, smooth filling that pipes easily.
*   **Emulsify the Garlic Butter:** Whisking the egg into the slightly cooled melted butter mixture is key. This prevents separation, creates a cohesive glaze, and gives a gorgeous sheen to the finished bread.
*   **Don't Skimp on the Glaze:** Be generous when coating the bread. The garlic butter glaze is what gives this dish its signature flavor and texture. Dunking is often better than just brushing for maximum coverage.
*   **Mince Garlic Finely:** Very finely minced garlic ensures even distribution of flavor without large, potentially bitter chunks.
*   **Serve Warm:** Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is best enjoyed fresh out of the oven when the bread is soft, the filling is warm, and the crust is slightly crisp.

## Serving Suggestions

Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is versatile and can be enjoyed in many ways. It makes an excellent:

*   **Snack:** Perfect for an afternoon treat with a cup of coffee or milk tea.
*   **Appetizer:** A unique and impressive starter for gatherings.
*   **Brunch Item:** A delightful addition to a weekend brunch spread.
*   **Dessert:** Its sweet and savory profile makes it a satisfying end to a meal.
*   **Side Dish:** While less traditional, it can complement certain light savory meals.

## Variations & Substitutions

Feel free to experiment with your Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread to suit your taste preferences:

*   **Add a Spicy Kick:** Incorporate a pinch of red pepper flakes into the garlic butter glaze for a subtle heat.
*   **Different Herbs:** While parsley is standard, a tiny bit of fresh chives or basil could add a different aromatic dimension.
*   **Extra Cheese:** For an even richer experience, you could mix a small amount of shredded mozzarella into the cream cheese filling, though this deviates slightly from the traditional recipe.
*   **Vegan Version:** Use plant-based cream cheese, vegan butter, and a flax egg or other egg substitute for a delicious dairy-free and egg-free option.
*   **Adjust Sweetness:** Play with the amount of sugar or honey in both the cream cheese filling and the garlic butter glaze to find your perfect sweet-to-savory ratio.

## Storage Tips

While Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is undoubtedly best enjoyed fresh, you can store leftovers:

*   **Room Temperature:** It can be kept at room temperature in an airtight container for up to one day.
*   **Refrigeration:** For longer storage, refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 3-4 days. The bread may lose some of its softness.
*   **Reheating:** To revive its deliciousness, reheat in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 5-10 minutes, or in an air fryer for a few minutes, until warmed through and slightly crispy again. Avoid the microwave, as it can make the bread tough.

Making Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread at home is a rewarding experience that brings a taste of Seoul's vibrant food culture right into your kitchen. With its irresistible combination of soft bread, creamy sweet filling, and savory garlic glaze, this dish is sure to become a new favorite. So gather your ingredients, follow these steps, and prepare to indulge in one of the most exciting and delicious Korean baking trends around!
